metas.name: Get Huge: Looksmaxxing to Death
metas.description: An unflinching portrait of masculinity in the influencer age, where extreme biohacking, online performance and a series of suspicious deaths converge.

metas.name: Cars That Changed History
metas.description:
Cars That Changed History is a 2026 documentary docuseries airing on National Geographic.

Format: 1-season docuseries consisting of 6 episodes exploring engineering breakthroughs, historic rivalries, and the social impact of iconic vehicles.

metas.name: Swipe Right on the Devil
metas.description: Revisits the 2017 murder of 24-year-old Sydney Loofe, who disappeared and was later found dead after going on a Tinder date with Bailey Boswell.

metas.name: Super Scam Me
metas.description: After years of reporting on the scam industry, Mariana van Zeller enters one of her most immersive investigations to date. In a real-life social experiment, she builds a new online dating persona and goes undercover as the target of a romance scam to understand and expose the tactics, technologies, and psychological manipulations these criminals utilize to deceive their victims.

metas.name: Africa Earth's Wild Home
metas.description: Captures unprecedented behaviors, examine continental forces, and highlight life's adaptations. Features National Geographic Explorers and scientists working to understand and protect Africa's wildlife.

metas.name: The Swan: Behind the Mirror
metas.description: A look at the controversial 2004 reality series The Swan, which took self-proclaimed 'ugly ducklings' and set out to make them... not that.

metas.name: Chilean Mine Rescue: Race Against Time
metas.description: Following a mining accident in northern Chile, 33 miners are trapped deep underground. As the search for them begins, the men are fighting for their lives under extreme conditions.

metas.name: Welcome to the Family: The Murder of Dan Markel
metas.description: Explores the murder of Florida attorney and law professor Dan Markel. A brutal murder reveals the dark secrets of a wealthy Florida family.

metas.name: Somebody Knows Something
metas.description: Former law enforcement officer Kara Chamberlain investigates unsolved murders and missing persons cases, working with victims' families, police and online communities to generate new leads.

metas.name: The Shards
metas.description: The Shards is part teenage coming of age, erotic thriller and exploration of the untamed and mysterious era of Los Angeles 1981, tracking a group of privileged high school friends as a serial killer strikes across the city.

metas.name: Furious
metas.description: FBI agent Alice Black is on the hunt for a mysterious and calculating female serial killer. Both walk their own paths toward justice, and as their lives start to intertwine, the line between right and wrong begins to blur.

metas.name: The Promise: Finding My Mother's Killer
metas.description: Effie Entezari was shot outside her apartment complex. Her husband was convicted and spent 25 years in prison. Convinced of her father's innocence, the daughter spent millions and decades investigating the case to uncover the real killer.

metas.name: Best of the World with Antoni Porowski
metas.description: Follows Antoni Porowski as he travels through Paris, Mexico City, London and New York City to find places to eat, stay and enjoy while learning at inventive restaurants and exploring local culture.

metas.name: Squatters: Get the F*** Out of My House
metas.description: Experienced squatters are exploiting legal loopholes to live rent-free.

metas.name: Hokum
metas.description: When novelist Ohm Bauman retreats to a remote inn to scatter his parents' ashes, he is consumed by tales of a witch haunting the honeymoon suite. Disturbing visions and a shocking disappearance forces him to confront dark corners of his past.

metas.name: The Cult of NatureBoy
metas.description: In 2016, a rising social media star named Eligio Bishop, also known as “NatureBoy,” used his platforms to recruit followers into a group he called Carbon Nation, encouraging them to abandon their families and join his vision of a self-proclaimed Black utopia. What began as an alternative lifestyle community quickly evolved into something far more sinister.

metas.name: 4x20: Quick Hits
metas.description: This anthology series made up of four, twenty-minute films highlights what is arguably the world’s most beloved plant and the people who love it.

metas.name: #Skyking
metas.description: A troubled airport worker's impulsive decision to steal and fly a commercial plane becomes a gripping aerial drama that reflects deeper issues of mental health and working-class struggles in America.

metas.name: The Testaments
metas.description: This sequel to "The Handmaid's Tale" follows Agnes and Daisy, two teens in Gilead who must navigate an elite preparatory school where obedience is brutally enforced. Their bond becomes the catalyst that will transform their lives.

metas.name: Evil Lives Here: My Child the Killer
metas.description: Follows parents confronting the unthinkable truth that their child has grown into a monster who committed horrifying crimes, featuring first-person interviews.

metas.name: Friends Like These: The Murder of Skylar Neese
metas.description: Follows the investigation into the 2012 murder of West Virginia teen Skylar Neese, whose closest friends were implicated in her death, examining friendship and betrayal in the digital age.

metas.name: Predator Hunters
metas.description: Follows Tony Godwin and his work with cops who uncover online exploitation and bring perpetrators to justice before they harm children.

metas.name: Hunt for the Missing: Chicago
metas.description: In the series, retired Chicago Detective Pamela Childs revisits unsolved missing persons cases as she hopes to uncover new leads and find potential answers for the victims’ families.

metas.name: Ghost Elephants
metas.description: In Angola's mist-shrouded highlands, three KhoiSan master trackers embark on a spiritual quest to rediscover the legendary "ghost elephants" of Lisima, creatures presumed lost but remembered in ancestral trance, ritual, and memory.

metas.name: Inside the CIA: Secrets & Spies
metas.description: Unbelievable, untold missions from inside the world of espionage-told by the spies themselves. From real-life Jason Bournes to Bin Laden's take-down, each episode delivers cliffhanger-driven stories revealing the deadly work of the CIA.

metas.name: The Scream Murder: A True Teen Horror Story
metas.description: When high school student Cassie Stoddart was found stabbed to death in a house on the outskirts of Pocatello, Idaho, the community was gripped by fear that a random killer was on the loose.

metas.name: Mouth of the Wolf: Amanda Knox Returns to Italy
metas.description: Amanda Knox returns to Italy to confront Giuliano Mignini, the prosecutor who locked her up for a murder she did not commit.

metas.name: In the Blink of an Eye
metas.description: Three storylines, spanning thousands of years, intersect and reflect on hope, connection, and the circle of life.

metas.name: History's Deadliest with Ving Rhames
metas.description: Explores history's most astonishing killers - criminals, tyrants, natural disasters, deadly weapons, battles, and even islands - revealing the strange truths behind the world's most prolific and powerful forces of death.

metas.name: Memory of a Killer
metas.description: When hitman Angelo is hit with early onset Alzheimer's, his worlds collide, putting his family in danger.
